topicName: Change Data Capture (CDC) and Streaming Ingestion
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Change Data Capture (CDC) and Streaming Ingestion in Modern Data Warehousing"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Change Data Capture (CDC) is a design pattern used to track and capture row-level changes (inserts, updates, deletes) made to a database. Combined with streaming ingestion, CDC enables real-time data warehousing, moving away from traditional batch-oriented Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) pipelines."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"How CDC Works"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Instead of periodically querying tables for new or modified rows, which is computationally expensive and introduces latency, CDC mechanisms read the database transaction log (such as the MySQL binlog, PostgreSQL WAL, or Oracle redo log). This ensures low impact on the source operational database and high fidelity of event sequencing."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Log-Based CDC: Reads database transaction logs directly, offering the highest performance and reliability."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Query-Based CDC: Relies on triggers, timestamps, or version columns. Often causes performance overhead on source databases."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"Streaming Ingestion Architecture"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"A standard streaming ingestion pipeline architecture involves a source database, a CDC tool like Debezium, a streaming message broker like Apache Kafka, and a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"[Source Database] ---> (Transaction Log) ---> [Debezium CDC] ---> [Apache Kafka] ---> [Streaming Ingestion Connector] ---> [Data Warehouse]"},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"Implementation Example: Kafka Connect Configuration"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"To capture changes from a PostgreSQL database using Debezium and Kafka Connect, you deploy a connector using a JSON configuration payload similar to the following."},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"{
  "name": "inventory-connector",
  "config": {
    "connector.class": "io.debezium.connector.postgresql.PostgresConnector",
    "tasks.max": "1",
    "plugin.name": "pgoutput",
    "database.hostname": "postgres",
    "database.port": "5432",
    "database.user": "postgres",
    "database.password": "password",
    "database.dbname": "inventory",
    "database.server.name": "dbserver1",
    "table.include.list": "public.customers"
  }
}"},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"Handling CDC Data in the Data Warehouse"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"Once CDC events stream into the data warehouse landing zone, they must be processed to maintain an accurate current state or a complete historical audit trail. Modern data warehouses use MERGE statements to efficiently upsert (update/insert) streaming records."},{"order":15,"type":"code","text":"MERGE INTO target_customers AS t
USING staging_customers_stream AS s
ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHEN MATCHED AND s.op = 'd' THEN
    DELETE
WHEN MATCHED AND s.op IN ('c', 'u') THEN
    UPDATE SET t.name = s.name, t.email = s.email, t.updated_at = s.updated_at
WHEN NOT MATCHED AND s.op != 'd' THEN
    INSERT (customer_id, name, email, updated_at)
    VALUES (s.customer_id, s.name, s.email, s.updated_at);"},{"order":16,"type":"subheading","text":"Best Practices"},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Schema Evolution: Handle schema changes gracefully by utilizing schema registries (like Confluent Schema Registry) to prevent pipeline failures."},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Idempotency: Ensure downstream transformations are idempotent to safely handle duplicate events delivered at least once by streaming brokers."},{"order":19,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Micro-batching vs True Streaming: Evaluate cost versus latency tradeoffs. True streaming incurs higher continuous compute costs, while micro-batching every 1 to 5 minutes is often sufficient for most analytical workloads."}]
